title: Shinonome Ena — The Emotions In The Art〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm so exhausted...
It's been a long time since I last moved a bunch of heavy paintings around.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I really had no idea...
I mean, he used to be an actual starving artist. Him.)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: That was when I finally realized...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I can't live without art in my life.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: He can't live without art in his life...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to keep drawing! I have to keep drawing! If I keep drawing, then even I could...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, look at me... I don't have anything...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No talent... Nothing... Not like you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try drawing something. I don't know if it'll be any good, but I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(The same thing happened to me.
No matter how much pain I suffered as my art when unnoticed...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can't go back on my word after telling him, too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll start by doing a sketch. Then, I'll get to work on my stuff for N25. There's still some time until 25:00, so I'll log in first and—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I did ask you to pop over.
Plus, I have a feeling you'd get mad if I made you wait.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Why would I get mad?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, why'd you want to meet here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. There's actually something I wanna give you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
I got this cake just for you♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You went over to help with your dad's exhibit today, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I decided to get you a present since I thought you deserved a little reward!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
A present...? Wait, hang on!
This is from that shop I said I wanted to go to the other day!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You went and got this just for me...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Not only that, but it's your favorite baked cheesecake!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What's more, I even brought you a fork.
So, bon appetit!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, wait. What's really going on here?
This is a little suspicious.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? What are you talking about?
All I'm trying to do is congratulate you on a job well done.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get that...
But I feel like you're going kinda overboard with this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Lemme guess. You're gonna want me to return the favor twofold later, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, is that how you view me?
If you don't want it, then I can take it back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I want it! I'll have it now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Something still feels off...
But I'm not about to say no to this since I've been wanting to try it forever.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's so rich with cheese...
The jam even adds a nice bit of sourness!
And it all goes perfectly with this crust...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No wonder everyone's been talking about it...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks.
*Sigh*
Why is it that sweets taste so good when you're tired?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Did you have a pretty long day...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It wasn't bad or anything...
But a lot did happen.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, it ended up being a good learning experience. Plus, it was the first time in a while that I looked at his paintings.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, all in all, I'm glad I went.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait a second... Was Mizuki worried about me going to the exhibit...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is that what this cake is for...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I didn't realize just how much worry I caused...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks. For this cake, and everything else...
